services.name: Schoodic Point
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. 25 Minutes About This picturesque flight brings you towards Downeast Maine, flying by Hulls Cove, Bar Harbor, Sand Beach, Egg Rock Lighthouse then on to Winter Harbor and its lighthouse with spectacular views of Schoodic Point, Frenchman Bay and many inlets. There is an additional $40 for single passenger 25 Minute Flight · Schoodic Point is part of Acadia National Park

services.name: All Acadia
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. 35 Minutes About You will enjoy fantastic views of the whole Mount Desert Island on this popular flight as it flies around the entire perimeter shoreline, highlighting Bar Harbor, Cadillac Mountain, Northeast Harbor, Southwest Harbor, Bass Harbor then on to the beautiful cliffs, mountains and islands along the western shore. This tour showcases three historic lighthouses. There is an additional $50 charge for single passenger 35 Minute Flight · Our Most Popular Flight!

services.name: Fall Foliage Flight
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. About: On this picturesque flight, you will fly along the eastern coast of Mount Desert Island to Bar Harbor, seeing Cadillac Mountain before crossing Frenchman's Bay to head inland to Tunk Mountain. As you continue on, you take in bright fall colors, winding through the surrounding mountains, lakes and fields on the way back to the airport. There is a $50 additional charge for single passenger 35 Minutes · Experience the Fall Colors of Maine From Above!

services.name: Deluxe Lighthouse
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. 50 Minutes About See it all with this favorite flight! In addition to the beauty of the All Acadia tour of Mount Desert Island, your flight will head off shore to capture the stunning views of Schoodic Point to the east, Baker Island and the Cranberry Islands to the south and the Blue Hill area to the west. Seven coastal Lighthouses are highlighted on your journey. $60 additional for single passenger 50 Minute Flight · See Seven Lighthouses!

services.name: Deluxe Fall Foliage Flight
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. 50 minutes About This amazing flight is for those who want to take in the best of the Acadia region along with the beautiful fall colors that the area is known for. You will see the perimeter of Mount Desert Island and the three lighthouses that surround it similar to the All Acadia tour. In addition your pilot will fly inland around the mountains and lakes which host the most brilliant colors of the area. There is a $60 additional charge for single passenger 50 Minutes · The Ultimate Maine Fall Foliage Flight!

services.name: Historic Penobscot Bay Lighthouse Tour
services.desc: Two passengers minimum for this flight No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. 75 Minutes About This ultimate excursion will offer you stunning views of areas that few visitors witness. Enjoy the natural beauty of the Maine coast while savoring some of Maine’s best Lighthouses, shorelines and islands. Twelve Lighthouses along with Fort Knox and the Penobscot Narrows Bridge are highlighted on your personalized tour. This is a must-see for Lighthouse enthusiasts and those wishing to view the Maine Coast and Islands as only seen from the unique perspective of 75 Minutes · The Ultimate Way to See The Best of Maine!

services.name: Open Cockpit Biplane Flight
services.desc: No charge for ages 2 and under on an adult lap. Enjoy the wind in your hair in our 1930’s replica open cockpit Waco Biplane! About This old-time barnstorming nostalgic flight is designed to be share by up to two passengers sitting together side-by-side, depending on size. The pricing is for the flight, whether it is for one passenger or two. Choose between two flight routes: Frenchman's Bay (20 Minute Flight) or Blue Hill Bay (40 Minute Flight). 20 or 40 20 or 40 Minute Flight · Price Includes Up to 2 People
